name: Soundscape composition (Vancouver-school environmental)
lineage: Canadian-and-international compositional approach emerging in 1970s through R. Murray Schafer's World Soundscape Project at Simon Fraser University. Compositions integrate field-recorded environmental and ecological sounds with electroacoustic transformation, addressing acoustic-ecology and the listener's sonic-environmental awareness. Hildegard Westerkamp's Kits Beach Soundwalk (1989) and Schafer's Vancouver Soundscape (1973) constitute the canonical type-specimens.
recipe: classic North American mid-1970s soundscape composition, experimental Elec, musique concrete branch, ambient experimental electric dark ambient hauntology. field textural sampler. shoebox concert hall. large-diaphragm condenser, API 312 op-amp pre, API op-amp console, 1176 FET, API proportional-Q EQ. Studer 30ips tape plate reverb.
